description: Change Render Queue items' render settings (Render Settings dialog): apply a template (Best Settings, Draft Settings, DV Settings, Multi-Machine Settings or your own), set quality, resolution, disk cache, proxies, effects, solo switches, guide layers, colour depth, frame blending, field rendering, 3:2 pulldown, motion blur, time span, frame rate and Skip Existing Files, the log level and the completion notification, and optionally save the result as a template

colorDepth.description: "Color Depth": Current Settings, 8 bits per channel, 16 bits per channel or 32 bits per channel

diskCache.description: "Disk Cache": Read Only or Current Settings

effects.description: "Effects": Current Settings, All On or All Off

fieldRender.description: "Field Render": Off, Upper Field First or Lower Field First

frameBlending.description: "Frame Blending": Current Settings, On for Checked Layers or Off for All Layers

frameRate.description: Frame rate: a number of frames per second, or "comp" for the composition's rate

guideLayers.description: "Guide Layers": Current Settings (render guide layers in the top composition) or All Off

logType.description: Log: errors only, plus settings, or plus per-frame information

motionBlur.description: "Motion Blur": Current Settings, On for Checked Layers or Off for All Layers

notify.description: Send a Creative Cloud notification when this item finishes (the Notify checkbox)

proxyUse.description: "Proxy Use": Current Settings, Use All Proxies, Use Comp Proxies Only or Use No Proxies

pulldown.description: "3:2 Pulldown": Off or a phase such as WSSWW

quality.description: "Quality": Current Settings, Best, Draft or Wireframe

resolution.description: "Resolution": Current Settings, Full, Half, Third, Quarter or Custom

saveAsTemplate.description: Save the first item's resulting render settings as a template with this name

settings.description: Any other settings by the English name After Effects gives them (get_render_item shows the settable names and current values), e.g. { "Quality": "Best" }

skipExistingFiles.description: Skip frames already in the output folder, so several computers can render one image sequence

skipFrames.description: Frames to skip between rendered frames for quick tests; 1 renders on twos

soloSwitches.description: "Solo Switches": Current Settings or All Off

template.description: Render settings template applied first, e.g. "Best Settings", "Draft Settings", "DV Settings", "Multi-Machine Settings" (list_render_templates lists them)

timeSpan.description: "Time Span": Length of Comp, Work Area Only or Custom

name: set_render_settings
title: Set Render Settings
